description: Plant process data from uns_metrics_1m_enriched. Counters and totals are kept off the rate charts so they cannot flatten the axis. Site and line fall back to the topic path when enrichment is null.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT topic) AS "Topics" FROM uns_metrics_1m_enriched WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) AND topic LIKE '%$topic%' AND metric_name = 'value'

SELECT count(DISTINCT split_part(topic, '/', array_length(string_to_array(topic, '/'), 1))) AS "Signals" FROM uns_metrics_1m_enriched WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) AND topic LIKE '%$topic%' AND metric_name = 'value'
SELECT coalesce(sum(sample_count), 0) AS "Samples" FROM uns_metrics_1m_enriched WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) AND topic LIKE '%$topic%' AND metric_name = 'value'

panels.description: Instantaneous process values only. Totals, counts and run-hours are excluded so one counter cannot squash the rest of the plant to a flat line.

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket AS time, avg_value_double AS value, COALESCE(NULLIF(site, ''), split_part(topic, '/', 2), '—') || ' / ' || COALESCE(NULLIF(line, ''), split_part(topic, '/', 4), '—') || ' / ' || split_part(topic, '/', array_length(string_to_array(topic, '/'), 1)) AS metric FROM uns_metrics_1m_enriched WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) AND topic LIKE '%$topic%' AND metric_name = 'value' AND avg_value_double IS NOT NULL AND split_part(topic, '/', array_length(string_to_array(topic, '/'), 1)) LIKE '%$metric%' AND split_part(topic, '/', array_length(string_to_array(topic, '/'), 1)) !~* '(total|count|hours|cycles|density|viscosity)$' ORDER BY 1

panels.title: All process values

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket AS time, avg_value_double AS value, COALESCE(NULLIF(site, ''), split_part(topic, '/', 2), '—') || ' / ' || COALESCE(NULLIF(line, ''), split_part(topic, '/', 4), '—') || ' / ' || split_part(topic, '/', array_length(string_to_array(topic, '/'), 1)) AS metric FROM uns_metrics_1m_enriched WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) AND topic LIKE '%$topic%' AND metric_name = 'value' AND split_part(topic, '/', array_length(string_to_array(topic, '/'), 1)) IN ('ProductionRate', 'ThroughputTph', 'CycleTime') ORDER BY 1

panels.description: OMAC PackML numeric state. 6 is EXECUTE.

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket AS time, avg_value_double AS value, COALESCE(NULLIF(site, ''), split_part(topic, '/', 2), '—') || ' / ' || COALESCE(NULLIF(line, ''), split_part(topic, '/', 4), '—') AS metric FROM uns_metrics_1m_enriched WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) AND topic LIKE '%$topic%' AND metric_name = 'value' AND topic LIKE '%/PackMlStateCode' ORDER BY 1

SELECT bucket AS time, avg_value_double AS value, COALESCE(NULLIF(line, ''), split_part(topic, '/', 4), '—') || ' / ' || split_part(topic, '/', array_length(string_to_array(topic, '/'), 1)) AS metric FROM uns_metrics_1m_enriched WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) AND topic LIKE '%$topic%' AND metric_name = 'value' AND split_part(topic, '/', array_length(string_to_array(topic, '/'), 1)) ~* 'temp' ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket AS time, avg_value_double AS value, COALESCE(NULLIF(line, ''), split_part(topic, '/', 4), '—') || ' / ' || split_part(topic, '/', array_length(string_to_array(topic, '/'), 1)) AS metric FROM uns_metrics_1m_enriched WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) AND topic LIKE '%$topic%' AND metric_name = 'value' AND split_part(topic, '/', array_length(string_to_array(topic, '/'), 1)) ~* 'flow' AND split_part(topic, '/', array_length(string_to_array(topic, '/'), 1)) !~* 'total' ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Cumulative counters on their own axis.

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket AS time, avg_value_double AS value, COALESCE(NULLIF(line, ''), split_part(topic, '/', 4), '—') || ' / ' || split_part(topic, '/', array_length(string_to_array(topic, '/'), 1)) AS metric FROM uns_metrics_1m_enriched WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) AND topic LIKE '%$topic%' AND metric_name = 'value' AND split_part(topic, '/', array_length(string_to_array(topic, '/'), 1)) IN ('GoodCount', 'RejectCount', 'TotalCount', 'VolumeTotal', 'FlowTotal', 'EnergyTotal', 'RunHours', 'StartCount', 'LoadUnloadCycles', 'ProductVolumeTotal') ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Counters

targets.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (topic) bucket AS time, COALESCE(NULLIF(site, ''), split_part(topic, '/', 2)) AS site, COALESCE(NULLIF(line, ''), split_part(topic, '/', 4)) AS line, split_part(topic, '/', 3) AS area, split_part(topic, '/', array_length(string_to_array(topic, '/'), 1)) AS signal, avg_value_double AS value, COALESCE(unit_of_measure, '') AS uom FROM uns_metrics_1m_enriched WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) AND topic LIKE '%$topic%' AND metric_name = 'value' AND avg_value_double IS NOT NULL AND split_part(topic, '/', array_length(string_to_array(topic, '/'), 1)) LIKE '%$metric%' ORDER BY topic, bucket DESC
